requested_by: Maintainer, 2026-09-10: preserve capacity for foreground work during training.
scope: This Goal 22 task background training, preflight, evaluation and compiler processes only. Not an application runtime setting or machine-wide policy.
limitations: Parallelizable work may use all 16 logical processors; serial portions cannot be spread automatically.
The Windows job limits aggregate CPU time to 50%; Idle priority favors foreground work. It does not cap disk or memory.
The new training thread count requires export parity and is recorded in the candidate recipe. Historical sources and outcomes remain unchanged.

live_training_sample.note: Brief process-time sample has collection and scheduling-interval error; configured Windows job hard cap remains 50%. This confirms actual multithread activity, not just processor eligibility.

independent_review.scope: All-thread affinity, Idle priority, inherited Windows job hard CPU cap; single heavy job required.
